name: spatial coherence
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 不同空间位置激励在频率域中的相关特征。
usage_overview: 空间相干性用于描述同一轨道不平顺在不同轮轨接触点形成的激励关联，体现不同轮对先后经过同一空间激励时的相位与时延关系，用于分析这种关联对车辆频率响应的影响。

complete_examples.text: This spatial coherence is important to the system response.

It can also be observed from Fig. 22(a) that due to the spatial coherence of the four wheelsets, the car body acceleration has a cancelation phe nomenon at some frequencies.
